title: Integrate opt-in bit-channel analysis into simulation workflows
description:
Integrate bit-channel analysis collectors into the simulation surface in a way that preserves the existing fast path when analysis is not enabled.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Simulation workflows can request bit-channel analysis explicitly.
- [ ] When analysis is disabled, the simulation path does not perform analysis-specific collection or bookkeeping work.
- [ ] Analysis integration does not create a second source of modem functionality inside the simulation layer.

## Notes

This task must preserve zero-overhead intent for non-analysis simulations as a hard design constraint.
